check_script |retired-skills-absent| |R=
f="$R/app/retired-skills.txt"
names="$(grep -vE "^[[:space:]]*(#|$)" "$f" 2>/dev/null)"
[ -n "$names" ] || { echo "no retired skill name readable from $f" >&2; exit 1; }
for n in $names; do
  if test -e "$R/opt/data/skills/$n" || test -L "$R/opt/data/skills/$n"; then
    echo "retired skill still on volume: $n" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done|
check_report |staged-scripts-current| |# staged-scripts-current
root="${SMD_SMOKE_DATA_ROOT:-/opt/data}"
if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  digest() { sha256sum "$1" | cut -d " " -f 1; }
else
  digest() { shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d " " -f 1; }
fi
bad=0
checked=0
for staged in "$root"/profiles/*/scripts/*/*.py; do
  [ -f "$staged" ] || continue
  checked=$((checked + 1))
  skill_dir="$(dirname "$staged")"
  skill="$(basename "$skill_dir")"
  profile="$(dirname "$(dirname "$skill_dir")")"
  file="$(basename "$staged")"
  src="$profile/skills/$skill/$file"
  [ -f "$src" ] || src="$root/skills/$skill/$file"
  if [ ! -f "$src" ]; then
    echo "stale: $staged has no skill copy"
    bad=1
  elif [ "$(digest "$staged")" != "$(digest "$src")" ]; then
    echo "stale: $staged differs from $src"
    bad=1
  fi
done
echo "checked: $checked staged script(s)"
exit "$bad"|
check_script |omitted-skills-absent| |/opt/hermes/.venv/bin/python3 -c '
import os, sys, yaml
p = os.environ.get("SMD_CUSTOMER_YAML_PATH") or next((c for c in ("/var/lib/smd-config/customer.yaml", "/opt/data/customer.yaml") if os.path.exists(c)), "")
doc = yaml.safe_load(open(p)) or {}
on = {s["name"] for q in doc.get("personas") or [] for s in (q or {}).get("skills") or [] if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("enabled") is not False and isinstance(s.get("name"), str)}
if not on:
    sys.exit("no enabled skill read from customer.yaml")
left = sorted(n for n in os.listdir("/app/skills") if n not in on and os.path.lexists(os.path.join("/opt/data/skills", n)))
sys.exit("omitted skills on the volume: " + " ".join(left) if left else 0)
'|
check_script |hermes-plugins-installed| |R=
"$R/opt/hermes/.venv/bin/python3" - "$R/opt/data" <<'PY'
import glob, sys, yaml
root = sys.argv[1]
dirs = [root + "/plugins/hermes-smd-overlay"] + sorted(glob.glob(root + "/profiles/*/plugins/hermes-smd-overlay"))
if len(dirs) < 2:
    sys.exit("no profile carries the overlay plugin")
for d in dirs:
    try:
        open(d + "/__init__.py").close()
        doc = yaml.safe_load(open(d + "/plugin.yaml"))
    except (OSError, yaml.YAMLError) as exc:
        sys.exit(f"{d}: {exc.__class__.__name__}")
    if not isinstance(doc, dict):
        sys.exit(f"{d}/plugin.yaml is not a mapping")
PY|

check_script |hermes-overlay-selected-in-config| |R=
"$R/opt/hermes/.venv/bin/python3" - "$R/opt/data" <<'PY'
import glob, sys, yaml
root = sys.argv[1]
K = "hermes-smd-overlay"
paths = [root + "/config.yaml"] + sorted(glob.glob(root + "/profiles/*/config.yaml"))
bad = []
for p in paths:
    try:
        c = yaml.safe_load(open(p)) or {}
    except (OSError, yaml.YAMLError) as exc:
        bad.append(f"{p}: {exc.__class__.__name__}")
        continue
    pl = c.get("plugins") if isinstance(c.get("plugins"), dict) else {}
    if K not in (pl.get("enabled") or []) or K in (pl.get("disabled") or []):
        bad.append(f"{p}: {K} not in plugins.enabled")
    if ((c.get("security") or {}).get("allow_lazy_installs")) is not False:
        bad.append(f"{p}: security.allow_lazy_installs is not false")
if len(paths) < 2:
    bad.append("no profile config.yaml")
sys.exit("; ".join(bad) if bad else 0)
PY|

check_script |gateway-multiplex-standalone| |R=
"$R/opt/hermes/.venv/bin/python3" - "$R/opt/data/profiles" <<'PY'
import glob, json, os, sys, time
WANT = "this profile is standalone (gateway.standalone: true); it serves only itself"
live = []
for beat in sorted(glob.glob(sys.argv[1] + "/*/state/gateway.heartbeat")):
    if time.time() - os.stat(beat).st_mtime < 120:
        live.append(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(beat)))
if not live:
    sys.exit("no profile has a fresh gateway heartbeat")
for home in live:
    try:
        with open(home + "/gateway_state.json", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            reason = (json.load(fh) or {}).get("multiplex_standalone_reason")
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        sys.exit(f"{home}/gateway_state.json: {exc.__class__.__name__}")
    if reason != WANT:
        sys.exit(f"{os.path.basename(home)}: multiplex_standalone_reason={reason!r}, want the gateway.standalone guard")
PY|
